title: SetRegularKey
key_points: The SetRegularKey transaction sets the regular key for a new account.
It takes three fields: Account, RegularKey, and Timestamp.
The RegularKey field specifies the key to set as the account's regular key.
limitations: Limited context outside of technical XRPL documentation
asserts: The SetRegularKey transaction allows setting a specific key as the regular key for a new account on the XRPL blockchain.
scope: The scope of this assertion is within the context of the XRPL protocol and its transactions, specifically focusing on the SetRegularKey transaction.
